note: Reported, never scored. Nothing here feeds the research queue, which is built from filings alone. New registrations are the one genuinely early signal available for free: a company files an S-1 weeks before it trades. Headlines are the weakest item here by a distance - a price absorbs news in milliseconds, so anything you read has already been paid for. It is here to explain a move, not to catch one.
